rows.definition: CREATE TRIGGER assign_profile_codes BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF customer_code, referral_code ON public.profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION assign_profile_codes()
CREATE TRIGGER normalize_profile_phone BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF phone ON public.profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION normalize_profile_phone()
rows.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_profile_phone()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  NEW.phone := public.normalize_nigerian_phone(NEW.phone);
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

rows.definition: CREATE TRIGGER reset_phone_verification BEFORE UPDATE OF phone ON public.profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reset_phone_verification()
CREATE TRIGGER add_transferable_tokens_from_ledger AFTER INSERT ON public.token_ledger FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION add_transferable_tokens_from_ledger()
rows.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.add_transferable_tokens_from_ledger()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.tx_type IN ('referral_unlock', 'reward', 'purchase', 'transfer_in')
     AND NEW.to_available > 0 THEN
    UPDATE public.token_accounts
    SET transferable_tokens = LEAST(available_tokens, transferable_tokens + NEW.to_available),
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE customer_id = NEW.customer_id;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
